item.title: Safari Guide from Savannah Adventures, the African David Livingstone
item.description: African hospitality combined with International Know How​Bio: Savannah Adventures is a Zimbabwean Safari Company based in Victoria Falls. Taurai Mandeya is Director of operations and Taf Mashiri director of reservations. Administration and online Marketing is done with a partner from Germany that handles the online part of Savannah Adventures. Together and in Teamwork with our European Marketing office we bring the wonders and spirit of Africa to the world. Our licensed guiding team is complete

item.title: Mr Zim 2022 Face of Savannah Adventures
item.description: We proudly announce that Future Nyoni aka Mr Zim 2022 and 2023 is the face of Savannah Adventures again in 2023.Those pictures were taken on a photo soot with Savannah Adventures in Zambezi National Park while leopards were sighted in the area. Keep up the excellent work and looking forward to work with Mr Zim again in 2023.

item.title: Victoria Falls and bridge with Safari Guide from Savannah Adventures
item.description: Come and experience the majestic Falls, the historic bridge of Victoria Falls and the stunning views of the gorge and the Zambezi river below on one of our walking tours with on of our licensed Savannah Adventure guide, cheers!
